policy: No development fixture, previously used reference, asset-specific builder, or post-seen threshold may count as held-out evidence.
reason: The online CC0 boombox benchmark passed its predeclared normalized front/side/top/mean silhouette gates at 0.8710/0.7566/0.8201/0.8159, with 15/15 fresh-process scene assertions and a 41-mesh GLB round trip; primitive-assembly and two bevel-damage approaches were rejected and retained. The CC0 camera family passed its own automated gates at 0.872 mean IoU but was overturned by experienced review for treating compatible radial details as separate assemblies; nine further rejected iterations (square lens, overdense controls, incomplete/misplaced weighting, and three pre-rounded-body attempts) are retained before the accepted one-object, literal-box, 492/492-weighted-edge correction reached 0.822 mean IoU and 24/24 fresh checks. The CC0 vintage telephone wall clock passed 0.840 mean IoU with a connected 208-quad housing and 162-quad handset, plus a real Cycles selected-to-active tangent bake and fresh Godot 4.7.1 import. The CC0 metal watering can passed 0.901 mean IoU with a 16-sided vessel, 12-sided spout, and one closed all-quad handle path loft (a converted-curve handle was rejected for non-manifold cap islands first), plus its own tangent bake and Godot import. The CC0 articulated desk-lamp attempt is retained as REJECTED: its all-quad mechanical assemblies passed technical checks but its best frozen three-view mean IoU was only 0.405845, not its 0.66 gate; live user feedback on this failure (blanket smooth shading with no semantic bevel weights or SubD) drove the separate hard-surface shading policy correction in `runs/2026-08-12_hard-surface-shading-policy/`, which is a runtime/tooling capability increment, not a modeled reference and therefore not counted toward the reference pool. Collectively this closes the automated portion of ladder E across five unrelated product families, not professional readiness: exact surface detail, broader held-out families, low-intervention runtime planning, and experienced human acceptance remain open for every passed entry above. Six supplied references remain unmodeled and reserved; sculpt-heavy organic benchmarks remain P2/KNOWN-DEFERRED.
